title: The Father Pouring the Strongholds Down to the Earth
description: A two-stage cosmic surgery: the Father of Life pours the three strongholds (Water, Darkness, Fire) down from heaven onto the earth, then draws them back upward, so that the buried kindred-elements still trapped in the natural can be drawn out by correspondence-of-likeness. The salty sea, the mountain of darkness, and the fire-springs are the visible scars in nature where extracted residue is held. The cleansed firmaments become the road of the Illuminators.
